seq.description: Sequence number of the request this response answers.

exit_code.description: Exit status of the command. A command killed by a signal reports 128 plus the signal number, so a timeout kill reports 137.

stdout.description: Everything the command wrote to standard output, base64-encoded.

stderr.description: Everything the command wrote to standard error, base64-encoded.

timed_out.description: True when the command hit `timeout_ms` and was killed.

truncated.description: True when stdout or stderr hit `max_output` and was cut short.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time the command took, in milliseconds. Measured in the guest, so it excludes protocol framing and transport.

error.description: Set when the agent could not run the command at all: an unusable `cwd`, an unknown op, or a response too large to frame. Empty on a normal run, including a normal non-zero exit.
